$comment: The three clocks the site shows: what operates today, what opens or is targeted in 2026, and what is on the horizon. Each item quotes its own doc in `match`; site/src/data/corridor.test.ts fails when the text leaves that doc. Company roadmaps stay on the horizon clock as goals, never deliveries (energy_why_and_how.md, rule 5).

items.match: An operating cleanroom is here: the NIST Boulder Microfabrication Facility
